acceptanceCriteria: Decide a delimiter convention (or record why none) that distinguishes a stale truncated header from a deliberately short one.
If adopted: specindex reports the stale-prefix case with a test, passes on all current specs, and one mutation shows the check bites.
body: Residual from the V1-0887/V1-1403 heartbeat lane (PR #920, branch claude/tasks-heartbeat-o1-0887-1403, head 308b06a1e, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores, load 35-39). checkDigest's containment rule accepts a header 'Delivery status:' that is a stale prefix of the digest '- Status:' delivery clause (the V1-1403 drift). Survey: 202 specs, 195 with a digest status; 110 pair tightly, 85 elaborate legitimately beyond a short header, so a naive equality gate would be wrong. A mechanical check needs a shared delimiter convention first.
title: specindex: detect a stale long 'Delivery status:' header that is only a prefix of the Agent digest delivery clause
